title: How to Use Facebook Lookalike Audiences

facts.fact: A Facebook lookalike audience is defined on the page as a method of reaching people who have similar interests and demographics to an existing customer list.
facts.quote: A Facebook lookalike audience is a method of reaching people who have similar interests and demographics to your existing customer list.

facts.fact: The page states that a Facebook Pixel is a small piece of code installed on a website to track data and track events used for lookalike audiences.
facts.quote: a small piece of code that you install onto your website to track data

facts.fact: The page advises that a business with no existing customers can choose website visitors instead of buyers as the custom audience source for a lookalike audience.
facts.quote: If you’re a new business that doesn’t have any existing customers, you can choose website visitors instead of buyers.

facts.fact: The vendor's newsletter reports 23,739 subscribers, according to the page's own sign-up banner.
The vendor Klientboost's banner claims it hit 84% of client goals in Q3, 2026.
facts.quote: We Hit 84% of Client Goals In Q3, 2026.
